NONE: › to cause someone to feel calm or to feel that they want to sleep
› a short period of calm in which little happens

example: The motion of the car almost lulled her to sleep.
汽車的顛簸讓她昏昏欲睡。
There has been a lull in the fighting.
戰鬥中出現了一段間歇。

NONE: › to make someone feel safe in order to trick them

example: Most exercise classes start gently, lulling you into thinking that you're in good shape.
健身課程一開始大多都很容易，讓人誤以為自己很健康。
Their promises lulled us into a false sense of security (= made us feel safe, when in fact we were not).
他們的承諾讓我們以為很安全。

NONE: › a quiet song that is sung to children to help them go to sleep
› something that is extremely good or extremely bad
極端的事例；極好（或極壞）的事

example: I've seen a few black eyes in my time but that's a lulu!
我以前也見過幾個被打得烏眼青的傢夥，不過那個傢夥可是被打得太慘了！
